notes.manas-2010:p1237:b001:l001: Tümön as myriad in countless herds, not a certified numerical ten-thousand multiplication.
notes.manas-2010:p1237:b001:l006: Dygdyrylt- / durgushta- sound and motion of crowded galloping herd, provisionally clatter/thunder; no invented separate instrument.
notes.manas-2010:p1237:b001:l017: Chettesh- construed skirmish/contact, contrasting bettesh face-to-face next19; possible marginal/side confrontation rather than strict tactical category. No silent change to chektesh.
notes.manas-2010:p1237:b001:l027: Kök zhal wolf-man martial epithet of Syrgak, not literal hair color.
notes.manas-2010:p1237:b001:l035: Soul leaving at roar retains epic terror hyperbole.
notes.manas-2010:p1238:b001:l006: Zhyldyzy favorable star/countenance in appearance description; open/favorable rendering provisional, not an astrological identification. Original zhazyk right/favorable retained in raw.
notes.manas-2010:p1238:b001:l013: Bytkyl secluded/recessed water place; huge eye simile retained, no exact topographic dimensions.
notes.manas-2010:p1238:b001:l026: Beijing’s scourge literally source Bээжинге дүмөк although weapon belongs here to Kongurbay. No narrative correction to Kyrgyz enemy.
notes.manas-2010:p1238:b001:l031: Kara kalpak kyrgagy construed inverted nominal description black [is] cap brim, referring to Syrgak named34. Recurrent fixed Syrgak line1238/1485/1493 etc. Not Karakalpak ethnic assignment; precise figurative status unreviewed.
notes.manas-2010:p1238:b001:l032: Literal no concern for my brow/my eyebrows, bodily disregard before combat; not securely an idiom for worry only.
notes.manas-2010:p1238:b001:l035: Attribution of plain speech and clear sight to Kongurbay named37 provisionally follows delayed nominal subject, not Syrgak named34 in previous unit.
notes.manas-2010:p1239:b001:l002: Umash/umach wide-awake idiom not food: Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/умач/ and2015 https://el-sozduk.kg/УМАШ/. Printed sleep not emended to eyes.
notes.manas-2010:p1239:b001:l012: Right shoulder singular specifically retained, no symmetrical broad-shouldered substitution.
notes.manas-2010:p1239:b001:l015: Rock cutting + kyialash shared mountain slope understood familial landscape metaphor, supported Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/кыял/ kyialash and paired uyialash same nest. Path supplied minimally from slope context; exact image remains qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p1239:b001:l020: Köĭkashka renowned/distinguished champion established Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/koy-12/ explicit variant көйкашка; not unexplained transliteration.
notes.manas-2010:p1239:b001:l023: Reaching twenty this year retained rather than estimated calendar age19 or21.
notes.manas-2010:p1239:b001:l027: Falcon striking rock literal source image of rash vigor/peak condition, not rewritten as prey.
notes.manas-2010:p1239:b001:l028: Burku provisionally shortened burkan idol/divinity in invocation (same formula416:26), contrasting dictionary burku kind1836:16 which does not fit vocative. Allah/God alongside idol retained, no theological harmonization; exact contraction unverified.
notes.manas-2010:p1239:b001:l030: Zhöö külük kol swift foot-soldier force, not horse cavalry.
notes.manas-2010:p1239:b001:l033: Plural alarga to them retained after collective/singular maiden noun; not reduced to one bride.
notes.manas-2010:p1239:b001:l038: Proposed future son made watch-khan, not Syrgak; crown/throne inheritance conditional. No invented biological certainty.
notes.manas-2010:p1239:b001:l042: Extended object implicit until following continuation, no premature identification with spear/sword.
notes.manas-2010:p1238:b001:l028: Ochogor2015 dictionary explicitly miltelüü wick-fired musket: https://el-sozduk.kg/очогор/. Corrected flintlock to matchlock after source1240:6–8 wick ignition confirmed. English count unchanged.
